function.name: weather_forecast_get

If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

* Use an online world‑clock or time‑zone converter (e.g., “New York City time” in a search engine) – it will show the current local time in Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4 during DST).

If you’d like me to fetch the latest weather forecast for New York City (which sometimes includes the current hour), let me know and I’ll call the weather function.
